## History of Pyrento dot Net

"Pyrento" is an anagram of entropy, with the "py" moved to the front
which nicely emphasized my appreciation of python when site was
created.  The internet archive has the first listing in 2014, using a
reStructuredText document as its source. It has gone through pelican
and is now generated as part of a quarto workflow.
